method: Complete pinned source reading of ThemesScreen395 and WidgetsScreen518 lines; cross-reference already credited WidgetThemeUtil and SyncViewModel. Static UI/control-domain review only.
findings: Widget appearance controls expose exactly supported gradientIDs1..6 and six solid tints; Slider valueRange0..1 generates alpha0..255. This narrows v65: unknown gradient7..100 and out-of-range alpha are persisted/unexpected-input robustness concerns, not generated by normal controls. Initial alpha loaded from prefs is not clamped in this view.

Slider onValueChange invokes applyAndSaveAppearance every event: SharedPreferences apply then synchronous updateAllWidgets across all instances of five providers. No onValueChangeFinished/debounce/coalescing in caller. Potential frame/IO cost needs actual provider/runtime measurement; no slowdown magnitude claimed.

Appearance preferences global across all widget types/instances; no per-instance selection. Widgets preview lambdas paint independent Compose mocks rather than actual RemoteViews. Search preview uses fixed gray text/blue icon; runtime helper chooses foreground by dark mode/gradient. Preview cannot establish runtime contrast/layout parity.

Pure Light and Pure Dark solid tints are normal user options; runtime WidgetThemeUtil chooses foreground by theme mode, not tint brightness. Contrast issue therefore potentially reachable without corrupted settings (e.g light solid with dark-mode white text); exact platform color-filter composition still needs rendered verification.

Normal transparent default for music is converted to Crimson gradient in WidgetThemeUtil; preview music instead uses solid default dark red. Default other previews also use fixed dark colors irrespective current app light mode. No actual screenshots reviewed for these widgets.

Widget list contains five provider classes, same set as updateAllWidgets helper and duplicate ViewModel refresh list; resolves v65 pending list consistency for these explicit lists, not manifest/layout registration completeness.

Add checks API>=26 and isRequestPinAppWidgetSupported, calls requestPinAppWidget with no callback and ignores return. UI says Add, not successful completion; no false success notification here. Actual launcher approval/cancellation unqualified.

Widget rows use fixed preview width200 for search plus16spacer and weighted text/action. Narrow screens/large font may leave insufficient details space; no rendered/UI acceptance claim. Preview size descriptions are hand-written, not derived from provider XML.

ThemesScreen exposes DARK/SYSTEM/LIGHT and seven palette IDs. Comment six premium palettes is stale but user-facing list contains seven. onModeSelected/save methods asynchronous; view observes persisted state, no explicit error/pending indicator.

ThemeModeSlider unknown currentMode uses index0 (DARK) for sliding indicator while no label selected. WidgetThemeUtil unknown mode follows SYSTEM, so unexpected stored mode can produce inconsistent indicator versus effective widget theme. Normal control only produces valid strings.

Theme palette previews resolve explicit paired Light/Dark color objects; these are small decorative previews, not proof every component or widget applies theme. setThemeColor only saves DataStore in previously reviewed ViewModel; widget tint separate by design.
limits: No Android build/tests, Compose/RemoteViews rendering, preferences mutation, widget pinning, launcher/UI or network actions.
No new runtime or performance result; previous library test run unchanged.155/500 full repositories unchanged.
